scope: Official Llasa-1B, Llasa-3B and Llasa-8B, both Dia2 checkpoints, and the Dia 1.6B reference control.
pilot_selection: Eight evenly spaced source indices, chosen before evaluating variants. Diagnostic only.
protocol: Fixed English Emily reference. Seed 42. All full runs target 1,088 exact texts. Whisper-large-v3, no VAD, corpus WER/CER. These conditioning experiments do not replace the original unconditioned Dia/Llasa scores.
